name: 5127-batchdecode-llama4scout-tp8
model: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct -- an UNGATED MIRROR of `meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct` under the Llama 4 Community License; the mirror matches on every field that decides a shape or a code path. 217 GB of bf16 safetensors.
parallelism: tp8, tensor parallel only -- and forced: 217 GB of bf16 weights is 27 GB a rank across eight 80 GB cards.
architecture: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration: a vision tower (text-only workload, so it loads and stays idle) wrapping a 48-layer text decoder, hidden 5120, 40 query / 8 KV heads of head_dim 128, MoE on every layer with 16 routed experts top-1 plus one shared expert. 109B total, 17B active, bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 512 requests with a 2700 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix: 1000 prompt and 1000 output tokens, both FIXED, every request an independent draw, seed 42, sent to `/v1/completions` with `ignore_eos` so the output length pins at 1000.
purpose: A long-form text generation service on a 109-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, handling 64 concurrent thousand-token requests across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit 88799448006996eadd137b6bd6559069410e284a (v0.4.5-54-g88799448006).
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is dropped by the parser that reads this file.

# `unsloth/...` IS AN UNGATED MIRROR of `meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct` (Llama 4
# Community License). The mirror's `text_config` matches on every field that decides a shape or a
# code path, and dispatch is on `architectures` alone.
model-path: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct

tp-size: 8
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# LOAD-BEARING: the checkpoint advertises max_position_embeddings 10485760 and the engine sizes
# device-side per-request tables from that number, so unbounded the server never starts. 8192 is
# also the checkpoint's attention_chunk_size, and the longest request here is 1000 + 1000 tokens.
context-length: 8192

# Prompts are independent synthetic draws; with the cache off every request pays a real
# 1000-token prefill.
disable-radix-cache: true

random-seed: 42
